t: The elephant and the rope a motivational story about limiting beliefs today I'd like to tell you a short motivational story about how your beliefs can be holding you back and how to recognize when you're experiencing a sense of learned helplessness in your life

Author of this story is unknown it's frequently mentioned in personal development books as a classic example of how the littlest things can derail your success in life so let's dive into the story and afterward I'll share a few lessons you can learn from it Once Upon a time a man was walking through the grounds of a circus when he noticed something interesting
in one area all the elephants were secured only with a small rope that was tied around 1 ankle they didn't have chains they weren't in cages

Can we weigh anywhere from 5000 to 14,000 lbs the man quickly realized they could easily break these ropes and go stampeding through the circus grounds so the man asked a trainer why the elephants didn't try to break free and the trainer told him something interesting
he said when the elephants are very young and smaller in size we use these same ropes to tie them up
at that age the rope is strong enough to hold him so at first the elephants will try to break free but they quickly learn they're powerless to do so
Eventually they're conditioned to believe that it's impossible to break free from the rope and as adults they think the rope can still hold them so they don't try to fight it

now I'm not certain if this story is true or not but I think there's an important lesson you can learn from it the elephants in this case are experiencing learned helplessness this phenomenon occurs when someone has been conditioned to anticipate discomfort in some way without having a way to avoid it nor make it stop
after enough conditioning a person will stop any attempts to avoid the pain even if they see an opportunity to escape

With a fixed mindset if you go through life thinking that you can't do something just because you failed at doing it in the past instead it's better to develop what's known as a growth mindset to learn more check out our video on 11 strategies to develop a growth mindset which you can check out in the description box another lesson to learn is how your beliefs will often determine your success in life the elephants in this story couldn't break free simply because they thought they didn't have the power to make it happen

As Henry Ford once famously said whether you think you can or think you can't you're right you have to let go of your limiting beliefs in order to make the breakthroughs that are required for your ultimate success don't let other people tell you you can't do something and don't hold on to an assumption that you can't grow and learn from past failures so as we close out the video let me leave you with two simple questions

what ropes are currently holding you back and what can you do today to change these beliefs and take action on an important goal in your life so that's our inspirational story for today now if you'd like to read more stories like this then be sure to check out our blog post titled 31 best inspirational short stories with a motivating moral which you can find here
